title: Encrypted value integrity failure
brief: An encrypted value in the latest shop revision cannot be read. Find Argo CD's comparison error.

checks.question: Which Application has the comparison error?
checks.why: The list separates healthy and failed releases.

checks.question: What failed for an individual encrypted value?
checks.hint: Read the decryption error in Conditions.
checks.why: A value authentication failure needs a fresh encryption from known plaintext.

truth.cause: An encrypted value fails AES-GCM authentication
